technical_and_design_decisions: Preserve the existing project structure, build conventions, and backward-compatible public APIs wherever practical.
Implement the deployment abstraction as a small pluggable runtime SPI with stable interfaces and an adapter for the existing repository-based implementation.
Implement ModuleRunner as an isolated Spring Boot executable component with explicit dependency boundaries and support for container-provided configuration and lifecycle management.
Use repeatable automated benchmarks, preferably the repository's existing benchmark framework or JMH where appropriate, and record baseline versus improved results.
Add CI coverage for the install target in a clean checkout and isolated environment so that the verification reflects a real consumer installation.
Publish the XD and Kafka proof of concept as a self-contained samples-repository example with configuration, startup instructions, and minimal operational documentation.
Use parameter handling that avoids unnecessary shell escaping while preserving safe validation and correct handling of SQLServer and GPDB-specific differences.
assumptions: The existing source repositories, build infrastructure, test environments, and CI credentials are available and functional.
The specification represents one increment covering all eight user stories; no additional product discovery or stakeholder approval cycle is required.
U1 refers to completing a bounded set of already-known DEBS challenge tasks. The estimate excludes discovering or implementing a large, unspecified new algorithm.

The existing implementation provides most of the functionality needed for the jdbchdfs and TupleBuilder benchmarks, and benchmark work primarily involves harnesses, representative data, execution, and analysis.
The XD, Kafka, SQLServer, and GPDB environments can be run locally or through existing test infrastructure; provisioning a new production cluster is excluded.
The samples repository accepts a pull request and does not require a separate release train or extensive community review cycle.
Backward compatibility is required for existing repository-based deployment behavior while the new SPI is introduced.
ModuleRunner does not require implementing a new container orchestrator integration; it only needs to run correctly under standard container-managed lifecycle and configuration conventions.
One developer performs implementation, testing, documentation, code review preparation, and integration work. Estimates are work effort, not elapsed calendar time.
Effort includes normal debugging and regression testing but excludes major unrelated refactoring and post-release support.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the existing modules, build, deployment model, benchmark infrastructure, CI jobs, and relevant open work; refine task boundaries and establish baseline test and benchmark results.
Implement the remaining bounded DEBS challenge changes, execute the associated tests and validation, fix integration issues, and prepare the submission-ready output.

Add a clean-environment CI job or build variation that executes the install target, verifies expected artifacts and behavior, documents required setup, and validates the job on representative branches.

Package the XD plus Kafka proof of concept for the samples repository, add build and runtime configuration, provide startup and usage documentation, test the sample from a clean checkout, and prepare the repository change.

Update benchmark scenarios for the latest improvements, establish comparable before-and-after measurements, run representative workloads, analyze regressions and bottlenecks, and document the results and any required tuning.

Create or extend benchmark cases around TupleBuilder, generate representative input sizes and shapes, measure allocation and execution hotspots, validate repeatability, and record optimization recommendations.

activities.activity_name: Simplify GPDB parameters and cross-database validation
activities.activity_description: Design and implement the simplified GPDB parameter UX, update parsing and validation, preserve compatibility where possible, and execute Sqoop job tests against SQLServer and GPDB to identify and resolve database-specific behavior differences.

activities.activity_name: Migrate deployment to a pluggable runtime SPI
activities.activity_description: Define the deployment SPI, separate runtime concerns from the existing repository abstraction, implement the current repository-backed adapter, migrate callers and configuration, add unit and integration tests, and verify compatibility with existing stream and job definitions.

Design the ModuleRunner lifecycle and configuration contract, create the isolated Spring Boot application and packaging, connect it to the deployment SPI, support container-managed startup and shutdown, add health and error handling behavior, and test standalone and container-like execution paths.

Run the full relevant test suite, resolve cross-feature integration failures, update developer and operator documentation, review build and sample changes, assemble release notes, and prepare the complete increment for submission.
